data.name: Navratan
data.gender_notes: Navratan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Navratan is a Sanskrit word meaning 'Nine Gems'. In Hindu mythology, Navratnas refer to nine precious gems: Ruby, Diamond, Emerald, Pearl, Coral, Turquoise, Topaz, Conch Shell, and Crystal. These gems are believed to bring good luck and prosperity. The name Navratan carries the meaning “Nine Gems” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Navratan usually hope their child will grow to embody nine gems and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine protection and prosperity.
data.etymology: Navratan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Nine Gems.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Navratan total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The Navratans have deep rooted cultural significance in Hinduism. They represent the nine guardian deities, Navagrahas, in Hindu mythology. Navratan jewelry is popular not just in India, but worldwide, symbolizing prosperity, wealth, and good fortune.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the Navratnas are believed to represent nine planets and celestial qualities. Wearing the Navratan ring or jewelry is considered auspicious as it is believed to align the wearer's energy with the celestial forces, promoting spiritual growth and harmony. The Navratnas are thus considered powerful spiritual symbols, and the practice of wearing Navratan jewelry dates back to ancient times.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Navratan symbolizes the nine precious gems, representing the nine divine qualities within us: love, generosity, courage, patience, wisdom, faith, discipline, harmony and inner peace. These gems are worn to remind us of these virtues and help us embody them in our daily lives.
